title: Tizen OS 9.0
description: Tizen 9 introduces major enhancements: the PenWave engine delivers an infinite canvas and real-time drawing for creative workflows; the AI Avatar Framework enables the creation of virtual agents with lip-syncing, multilingual support and modular AI integration; the unified Memory Profiler tracks native and managed memory in real time for deep diagnostics; Android apps can now run natively on Tizen via a container to broaden compatibility; the Lightweight Web Engine cuts memory use dramatically while supporting full web standards; and full support for the RISC-V architecture prepares the platform for tomorrow’s hardware.
